evidence.quote: While the economy has recovered substantially from the effects of the pandemic, it is concerning to see signs that the improvements have been uneven, with some households continuing to struggle with unemployment and facing financial difficulty.
At the Federal Reserve, our community development mission is to promote economic growth and financial stability across the country, particularly in vulnerable communities.
The survey showed that employment disruptions and financial challenges disproportionately affected people of color and low-income families.
